entities.summary: Anti-Fascist Assembly, a political institution in North Macedonia during World Wars & Vardar Banovina (1918–1945). Grew from Serbian Rule & World War I. Led to the emergence of Yugoslav and ASNOM proclaims the People's Republic of Macedonia.
